operations.description:
The Enhanced Balance Sheet Accounts endpoint returns a list of categorized accounts that appear on a company’s Balance Sheet along with a balance per financial statement date.

Codat suggests a category for each account automatically, but you can [change it](/docs/assess-categorizing-accounts-ecommerce-lending) to a more suitable one.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] accounts for enhanced balance sheet [PATH] companies reports enhanced balance sheet accounts [PARAMS] company date id number of periods report [SCHEMA] account category currency enhanced generated info last report

operations.description: The Enhanced Cash Flow Transactions endpoint provides a fully categorized list of banking transactions for a company. Accounts and transaction data are obtained from the company's banking data sources.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] enhanced cash flow transactions [PATH] companies reports enhanced cash flow transactions [PARAMS] company id page query size [SCHEMA] accounts cash data enhanced flow info item report source transaction transactions

operations.description: Gets a list of invoices linked to the corresponding banking transaction
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] enhanced invoices report [PATH] companies reports enhanced invoices [PARAMS] company id page query size [SCHEMA] enhanced info invoice invoices item report

operations.description:
The Enhanced Profit and Loss Accounts endpoint returns a list of categorized accounts that appear on a company’s Profit and Loss. It also includes a balance per the financial statement date.

Codat suggests a category for each account automatically, but you can [change it](/docs/assess-categorizing-accounts-ecommerce-lending) to a more suitable one.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] accounts for enhanced profit and loss [PATH] companies reports enhanced profit and loss accounts [PARAMS] company date id number of periods report [SCHEMA] account category currency enhanced generated info last report
